prompt: Image 1 shows the art direction of a stylised game set on a Japanese volcanic island in autumn: soft painterly shapes, flat matte colour, warm light. The image: hand-dyed deep indigo cotton cloth covered edge to edge with a regular pattern of white overlapping wave arcs (seigaiha), the pattern repeating seamlessly on all four sides.
